source: McAuley Amazon Reviews 2023（公开研究数据集）
reviews: I bought this a gift for a friend who is part of a military family. They live in texas right now and she was looking an alternative to popcicles. She reports that this machine is awesome fun. Uses regular ice cubes and is very easy to run! I purchased extra paper cones, holders and flavorings. They are going to be the hit of the neighborhood this summer! Will update if there are any issues.
The whisk closes back to the flat position during use. There is no lock to keep it in place. Great space saving idea, but the design needs work.

This quilt is beautiful and the colors are just like it shows on the website. It is excellent quality, washes well without fading and is not too heavy or thick. The king size actually fits nicely and is not too short. I purchased this for Spring/Summer and think this will be just fine. You could also use this in winter by adding an extra blanket between sheets and quilt.

I purchased this mini hot plate to use with my very small battery box during a short power outage. It is super small - the burner is about the size of a cup warmer. But in a pinch, I think it will work well. I store it with the battery box in my outage emergency kit. I expect it work just as I need it to in a pinch - having said that - I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

I must have tried to use this with the wrong rubbermaid containers. I tried to push the container onto the little holder and I broke the peg under it. Note to everyone considering purchasing this, it is not for regular rubbermaid containers. You should buy a new set containers so they are all the same size or you won't really save space. It can only hold 2 stacks. You need deep drawers to use this.
Very thin. One didn't even have the rubber ring that seals the product. If they do not stay sealed I have wasted my time and money.

Cotton muslin bags - just as described. They are stiff - but did wash - if you want them crisp again, you'll need press them of course. They are a beige color. Draw string closure. I purchased them for my grandsons to keep their dug up pirate booty found in my sandy front yard. Works great for that. I am also going to use a couple in a craft project making tic tac toe boards with rocks. The bag is the board and storage for the rocks.
Soft and comfortable. The lettering is built in so it won't fade. Washes and dries well. Beautiful gift!

I've been using colorful plastic hangers for years and I often have the same problem with them. A lot of my blouses and tops have wide necklines and will slip off hangers. These hangers have the covering on them that helps to prevent them for slipping off. It's been a wonderful improvement! They're not super heavy duty. They're not going to hold the weight of heavy coats or full suits, but for my blouses, they are perfect. They also have the little hooks designed for thin straps.

Well made, very functional and nothing out there on the market like it. I love all of Garden Girl products. The owner and designer really understands function meets fashion. Can't wait to wear it next spring when I tend to my honey bees and many gardens.
Worked well for the first three months. Paddle froze while making pizza dough in middle of cycle. This caused the electronics to freeze forever on cycle one rendering the machine useless
Springform pan has issues. Does not close or fit correctly.

These are true blackout curtains. They're thick and a bit heavy. The rings are affixed well and are easy to hang on a curtain rod. The color is just as pictured. They look very nice when hung on the window and makes the window look great! This comes with 2 panels. My original intent was to just hang one panel on this window and the other on another window. However, I liked it enough that I purchased another set so I could have both panels on each window.

These measuring spoons are a great quality. They are sturdy and very durable. They are on a ring which opens easily to remove the one you need. I like the rectangular shape a lot because it is easier to fit down into most spice jars. This set comes with a bonus item. It's a tool to level the measurement spoons for accuracy.
I think that $42.99 plus tax is way too expensive for this lightweight tray. The slats in the bottom are warped rendering it impossible to use it for other than decorating purposes.

This mattress is suppose to be Medium-Firm. It is really soft. I would hate to sleep on the soft one. You can not sit on the end of the bed you slide off. There is just no support on the sides. For a guess who is going to spend a couples of night it would be great. My 19 year old daughter tells me it is nicer than a box spring but not nearly as nice as my Temperpedic.

These are what you would expect - rings and lids. Work as you would expect. First order was damaged somehow and didn't arrive. Was refunded and reordered. Just a fluke. I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful. All my reviews reflect my honest, personal experience with the reviewed item - your experience may be different. I receive/accept NO free products or discounts that are not available to all shoppers.

You get a set of 6... 3 roll, 3 bell shaped - just as photographed. Gentle ring... not loud. The metal is painted and is very then. I purchased for package decor so they are good. They do come strung on a jute or jute-like rope, so you could hang on a tree right out of the bag.

These are very cute... but a little too shiny. The pic does show they are shiny, but I missed that... they would look a bit more real if they weren't so shiny! Regardless, they are nice little green spots. They are about 7 or 8" tall... the clear pots are glass, about 3x3? They are nice piece of spring! And guaranteed no watering necessary... just a little dusting every so often.

Bought these for family gatherings we have.. they are a nice size and could be used for drinks other than wine as well. They are plastic and lightweight.. but sturdy too. Chinet is a good brand in my mind and these are representative in my opinion. They are crystal clear. I never hesitate to update my reviews if new info would seem useful.
It broke the first time I tried to use it. The soldering at the connection point at the bottom snapped immediately after I removed the packaging.

These are amazingly bright for being such a tiny seed light. The wiring is nice and thin, Yet I'm not worried about it breaking when I bend it to wrap around things. The distance in between each light is very nice, so there are no large gaps. My fav thing is having the remote . Soon as it gets dark, I just click on the remote and my lights go on without leaving my recliner and blanket lol

This was a tad smaller than I envisioned. And part of the plastic was misshaped in the lowest ring. It's not very sturdy plasic. I am hoping it will work for our wedding macaroon tower. I will update once our wedding has happened & I can add photos.

This humidifier works well so far. Considering some of the reviews, pretty quiet operation. Reservoir does last for a long time if ran at lower output setting (logical). Not obvious in the room compared to decor. No light in the lower priced model. Auto shutoff worked fine. As described. Hope it lasts for a while.

I came across this butter knife and had to purchase it. Trying to butter certain items is so irritating to me. A knife that separates butter to make it spread easier? Yes! Works as stated. Makes buttering much easier. Nice design. Even my husband liked it. Washes up nicely in the dishwasher.
lovely spring wreath for my front door.

Beautiful quilt that fit my bed perfectly. I am replacing my heavy winter bedcover with this quilt for the spring and summer. I used it for the first time last night, and it was lightweight and comfortable.

This is a really pretty set. The tapestry type material is thick and the colors are rich and deep. It is slightly more deep red than I expected in person, but i like it and brings Fall decor into my home. You get 4 placemats and 1 table runner. Having said all of this, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

Love love love the smell of burning pinion wood is soooo nice. These smell very, very real - also - it is strong. I usually break the bricks in half and it's just about right. I use with my LED fireplace - along with my Amazon Alexa playing "crackling fire" it's almost like having a REAL fire. :)

I have purchased a number of these (gifts, daughter) and I love them. Air pops corn perfectly. The silicone lid is also the measuring cup. I use an olive oil sprayer to spray some olive oil instead of butter. Yum. It is all dishwasher safe. I really like it. I never hesitate to update my review should new info seem useful.

I bought this for entertaining at family/friends gatherings. I have two. One I use for coffee and this one I use for ONLY hot cider/punch. It worked well and kept the spiced cider very hot all night. I will post updates as it ages. For now, it works great.

I was so attracted to this online with the bright colors and bought it despite it being a small wreath. I was really disappointed when I got it. It is a full wreath for the size, but the colors in the wreath I received were dull and not spring-like at all. It you want a small wreath with muted colors, this one might be the one for you.
The boxes that the flowers were in are quite unattractive, but I took the flowers out and arranged them in a woven basket I had, and now I've got a very nice decorative display of spring flowers!

This arrived with one corner of the plastic box broken and the flip-up spout missing entirely! Could possibly make it work for storing flour, but it's absolutely worthless for air-tight storage. Will never order from this company (Prepworks) again!

My husband just finished installing hardwood flooring in our bedroom. We have several rugs in place because we have an elderly cat that spends most of his time in the room. A couple of the rugs were sliding around when we walked on them. Luckily they didn't slip for him, but we didn't want to risk it. We had to trim this down to fit the intended rug, but there was enough left over to use on another rug. It works very well and we haven't had any issues with sliding rugs since!

I love this cob web decor. It's the perfect addition to my interior Halloween decor! I ordered this primarily for the mantle covering, but I'm using some of the other pieces as well. It's a nice set. The quality is decent. I am very pleased with the results.

This twin size mattress protector has a good fit. It's a soft terry material. It's not what I would call noisy, but it's not silent either. Sometimes with movement, I can hear a rustling type sound. It's not loud or annoying thankfully. Our guest bed is used by children or elderly people, so having a waterproof covering is important!

These wine glasses are absolutely gorgeous! I love them! I don't usually drink much wine, but I've indulged a couple of times this week just so I can use these glasses. They're a good size. The stem is sturdy. I'm mesmerized by the beautiful color designs. These would make a wonderful gift for someone. I'm considering ordering other pieces in the set because they're that pretty.

I use these to store yarn. They easily hold 12 of the 10.5 ounce Bernat Pipsqueaks yarn. The pic only has 11. I wish it had the zipper closure, but aside from that I love these bags. I wasn’t sure how I would like the blue color, but I find that it adds uniformity on my wire shelves so different colors of yarn aren’t glaring at me 24/7 & the blue is a calming color.

These are cute but I worried and it happened as other reviewers stated quite a few were very stuck together and ruined them even gently trying to separate. The few that remained I just used decoratively since there weren't enough to use as invitations. Cute idea -yes but quality control or packaging by manufacturing site is flawed
